newsitem.title: ITALY: IMI to have role in S Paolo offer.
newsitem.headline: IMI to have role in S Paolo offer.

text.p: Italian investment bank IMI will play a significant role in helping to handle a public offer of shares in Istituto Bancario San Paolo di Torino, IMI Director General Rainer Masera said.

"We will contribute actively to the public share offer. A number of operational agreements are in place for a significant involvement of IMI," said Masera, adding there was as yet no official mandate.
IMI has agreed to increase its stake in San Paolo from two to five percent and form part of a core of stable shareholders in the bank.
Masera said the move was "a strategic decision taken some time ago which shows the deep conviction that San Paolo is a great bank with extremely important development prospects".
He said IMI was committed not to lower or increase its stake in San Paolo for four years. -- Milan newsroom +392-66102321
